name: 4-HO-NiPT
summary: 4-HO-NiPT, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-isopropyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and putative psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families related to psilocin (4-HO-DMT). It is an analogue of 4-HO-MiPT (miprocin) and 4-HO-DiPT (iprocin) and a derivative of norpsilocin (4-HO-NMT) and 4-HO-NET. The drug has been encountered online as a possible novel designer drug.

pharmacology.text: 4-HO-NiPT shows affinity for serotonin receptors, including for the serotonin 5-HT1D, 5-HT1E, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, 5-HT2C, 5-HT6, and 5-HT7 receptors (Ki = 229–2,461 nM). Conversely, it did not show affinity for the serotonin 5-HT1B or 5-HT5A receptors, whereas the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor was not reported.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: The drug has been encountered online as a possible novel designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psilocin-like tryptamines, can cause nausea, yawning, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類、類似脫磷酸裸蓋菇素（psilocin）的色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类、类似脱磷酸裸盖菇素（psilocin）的色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It is the simpler relative of two better-known drugs: add a methyl group to its nitrogen and you get miprocin (4-HO-MiPT), add an isopropyl group and you get iprocin (4-HO-DiPT).
fact.zh: 它是兩種較知名藥物的簡化版：在它的氮原子上加一個甲基，就成為miprocin（4-HO-MiPT）；加一個異丙基，就成為iprocin（4-HO-DiPT）。
fact.zhHans: 它是两种较知名药物的简化版：在它的氮原子上加一个甲基，就成为miprocin（4-HO-MiPT）；加一个异丙基，就成为iprocin（4-HO-DiPT）。
